summary: Baozun Inc. furnished a routine Form 6-K covering Hong Kong Stock Exchange monthly and next-day disclosure returns for September 2026 share-capital movements. The filing includes Exhibit 99.2, the monthly return on movements in authorized and issued shares, plus Exhibits 99.1 and 99.3-99.6, next-day disclosure returns dated October 5-9, 2026, signed by CFO Catherine Yanjie Zhu. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or regulatory clock is stated. This is ordinary Hong Kong listing-rule share-movement reporting, not a special situation; no deal terms and no risk-arb angle apply.
